messages.text: For a Wireless Communication use case involving Wi-Fi 7/8, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

In a Wi‑Fi 7/8 wireless-communication test workflow, **Signaling and Non-signaling testers sit at different stages**:

### 1) Signaling tester: R&D / system validation stage  
Use a **signaling tester** when the DUT must behave like it is connected to a real network/AP environment.

For Wi‑Fi 7, the knowledge base positions **R&S CMX500** as a **multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester** for R&D. It fits where engineers need to validate:

- Real-world RF TX/RX behavior in **signaling mode**
- Wi‑Fi 7 operation with **MLO** and multiple RF chains
- **2x2 MIMO**
- 6 GHz operation and out-of-band discovery
- Coexistence and end-to-end behavior
- Cellular/WLAN interworking use cases such as WLAN offloading / Voice over WLAN

So in the workflow, this is mainly:

> **Design validation → feature bring-up → protocol/system behavior → coexistence/interworking → end-to-end application validation**

Source: KB page “Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production testing,” section “R&D: R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing”; and “Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi‑Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.”

---

### 2) Non-signaling tester: RF characterization / production stage  
Use a **non-signaling tester** when the goal is fast, repeatable RF measurement without full protocol/network signaling.

The KB positions **R&S CMP180** for **production-phase non-signaling RF measurements**, especially because production testing usually prioritizes speed. It supports Wi‑Fi 6E / Wi‑Fi 7 and other technologies, with bandwidths up to 500 MHz and operation up to 8 GHz in the cited positioning. It is also described as demonstrating a **480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback**, framed as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn candidate waveform rather than a finalized Wi‑Fi 8 specification.

So in the workflow, this is mainly:

> **RF characterization → calibration → verification → manufacturing test → production quality screening**

Typical measurements would include TX power, EVM, spectrum mask/SEM-style checks, frequency error, sensitivity/receiver checks, and MIMO RF-path verification, depending on configuration.

Source: KB page “Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production testing,” section “Production: R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing”; and “Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi‑Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.”

---

### Simple placement view

| Workflow phase | Tester type | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Chip/module bring-up | Non-signaling first, sometimes signaling later | Quick RF sanity checks before full connectivity |
| R&D feature validation | **Signaling tester** | Real Wi‑Fi behavior, MLO, MIMO, coexistence, E2E |
| RF performance characterization | **Non-signaling tester** | Precise, repeatable RF metrics |
| Pre-certification/debug | Both | Signaling for behavior, non-signaling for RF root cause |
| Production | **Non-signaling tester** | Fast test time, high throughput |
| Wi‑Fi 8 early waveform research | Non-signaling / waveform-capable RF tester | Candidate waveform generation/analysis before standard maturity |

### Key caveat  
The KB notes that the cited Wi‑Fi 7/8 material is PR / demonstration positioning, not a formal datasheet, certification test plan, or final Wi‑Fi 8 specification. In particular, the 480 MHz WLAN waveform is described as a **potential** Wi‑Fi 8 candidate, not an official finalized Wi‑Fi 8 requirement.

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單 › 目前已知內容
- [[Test House]] 只包含一個本機檔案連結：`無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx`。
- [[Test House]] 來源 converted 日期為 2026-09-17，但正文未標示正式發布日期或文件版次。
- 先前 [[Test House]] 沒有可抽取的簡報正文、圖表、標準清單、實驗室名稱、認證範圍或設備配置。
- [[無線通訊認證實驗室]]已補入該 PPT 的 markitdown 轉檔文字；raw frontmatter 顯示 converted 日期為 2026-09-17，但簡報本身仍未標示正式發布日期與版次。

NCC › 衛星 / 通訊監理語境中的 NCC
- [[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]（來源標示 111年08月）列出 NCC 電信事業申請衛星固定通信用無線電頻率核配有關事項草案、NCC 衛星地球電臺設置使用管理辦法部分條文修正草案，以及 NCC 衛星地球電臺設備技術規範草案總說明。
- 上述語境應連到 [[國家通訊傳播委員會]]，不應與交換機光器件圖上的 NCC 混用。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單
[[無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單]]原本由 [[Test House]] 提供待讀材料索引；[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]新增了[[電信技術中心]]在 111年08月簡報中的毫米波頻段測試量能描述；[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]則補入 `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` 的簡報正文摘要。

passages.text:
無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單 › 使用限制
- 不可把 [[Test House]] 的 OneNote 連結標題解讀為已驗證的實驗室能力、測試範圍或市場資訊。
- [[無線通訊認證實驗室]]是 company restricted 簡報轉檔，且正式日期 / 版次未標示；其能力、週期與機構列名需官方 accreditation scope、實驗室能力表或法規文件補證。
- 不可把 `NCC / TAF / FCC 等機構認可` 解讀為所有列名實驗室在所有測項、頻段與地區均已獲認可。
- 不可把 RF / EMC 測試 3–4 週、GMA 8–12 週解讀為任何產品的保證交期。
- [[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]中的 TTC CATR 能力是 111年08月簡報層級說法；不可取代 TTC 官方能力清單、TAF 認證範圍、測試報告或正式報價文件。
- 若要判斷 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]、[[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]、[[PTCRB]]、[[GCF]]、Wi‑Fi / BLE 認證流程，需回正式規則、標準與 certification body 文件。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

國家通訊傳播委員會 › 來源中的衛星規範脈絡
[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]（來源標示 111年08月）列出：

- NCC 電信事業申請衛星固定通信用無線電頻率核配有關事項草案：釋出同步及非同步衛星固定通信用無線電頻率，以供電信事業新設置衛星通信網路或衛星系統者進行相關申請。
- NCC 衛星地球電臺設置使用管理辦法部分條文修正草案：因應國際多家衛星系統業者積極布建衛星通信網路，增訂已辦理登錄或依電信法取得衛星地球電臺執照之天線直徑小於三公尺且具雙向通信功能之衛星地球電臺執照核發及換發規定。
- NCC 衛星地球電臺設備技術規範草案總說明：依電信管理法第六十六條第二項授權，作為衛星地球電臺設備製造商、進口商及經銷商等辦理型式認證之依據。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：新聞稿發布者與測試解決方案供應商。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：frontmatter author 與 R&S registered trademark 所屬公司名。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：R&D single-box signaling tester；本來源新增 Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality、WLAN offloading、N3IWF 與 POLQA voice quality measurement 的 PR 語境。
- [[R&S CMP180]]：production / R&D non-signaling tester；本來源宣稱支援 Wi-Fi 6E、Wi-Fi 7、5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz、bandwidths up to 500 MHz，並展示 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback。
- [[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]]：本來源的主題概念，區分 CMX500 R&D signaling 與 CMP180 production non-signaling 測試。
- [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]：本來源描述的 CMX500 single-box interworking / voice continuity 測試情境。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]：來源列出 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM、低延遲與 high throughput。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]]：來源稱 yet-to-be-defined，且 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion；CMP180 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate。
- [[MLO]]：Wi-Fi 7 key feature，使 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 變重要。
- [[N3IWF]]：Non-3GPP Interworking Function gateway；來源稱 newly integrated in R&S CMX500。
- [[POLQA]]：來源稱 R&S CMX500 integrated POLQA voice quality measurement function 可用於 Voice over WLAN applications。
- [[MWC 2024]]：展示場合。
- [[Christian Mokry]]：Press & media contact。

- 本來源補齊 [[Test House]] 原本只保存 `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` 本機簡報連結、尚未擷取正文的缺口。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。

無線通訊認證實驗室 › 重點摘要
本來源是由 `無線通訊認證實驗室.pptx` 轉出的 company restricted 簡報，正式發布日期與文件版次未標示；raw frontmatter 顯示 converted 日期為 2026-09-17。

來源將[[無線通訊認證實驗室]]定義為測試與驗證無線設備符合法規、安全與性能標準的實驗室，涵蓋 [[RF 測試]]、[[EMC]]、安規與一致性認證，並稱其可支援 [[Global Market Access]]（GMA）與加速上市。

主要內容包括：

- 無線設備認證實驗室涵蓋 RF、EMC、安規與一致性認證。
- 主要測試項目包含頻譜、輸出功率、[[DFS]]、[[SAR]]、EMI / EMS、靜電放電、電源突波、[[Protocol 相容性]]、互操作性測試與 [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] 認證。
- 來源稱認證必要性包括防止電磁干擾與頻譜衝突、保障用戶安全、加速上市、降低召回與法律風險，以及滿足台灣供應鏈衛星終端與 6G 等需求。
- 來源列出台灣 [[NCC]] 認證流程：準備文件 / 樣品 / 電路圖 / 天線規格、提交 [[RCB]] 核驗機構初審、[[TAF]] 認可實驗室 RF / EMC 測試約 3–4 週、報告審查與證書核發，並稱證書有效期 5 年。
- 來源列出台灣領先認證實驗室：[[耕興]]、[[SGS]]、[[電信技術中心]] / [[ISL]]。
- 來源稱[[耕興]]具 30 MHz–325 GHz 全頻段測試能力、108 座測試場地、連續 10 年 FCC 最佳實驗室認證、10 米半電波暗室、OTA / SAR / [[相控陣列天線]]測試等能力。
- 來源簡述 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]]、[[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]、Wi‑Fi / BLE 聯盟流程的差異。
- 來源將 LEO 衛星終端認證應用連到 Starlink / Kuiper user terminal RF validation、[[相控陣列天線]] beamforming 測試、mmWave / MIMO 高頻測試、台灣供應鏈 GMA，以及耕興等 [[RCB]] 提供 8–12 週 GMA 週期的說法。

answer.text:
### Short answer
A **Signaling Tester** fits in the **R&D / development validation stage**, where Wi‑Fi devices must be tested in **signaling mode under real-world conditions** for RF TX/RX behavior, MLO, MIMO, coexistence and E2E behavior.[5]  
A **Non-signaling Tester** fits mainly in the **production RF test stage**, where RF measurements are executed in **non-signaling mode to save test time**.[1]
| Workflow placement | Tester type | Role in workflow | Wi‑Fi 7 / 8 relevance |
|---|---|---|---|
| R&D / development validation | Signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMX500 | Tests wireless-device operation in cellular and non-cellular standards in a single-instrument setup.[5] | For Wi‑Fi 7, it supports signaling-mode RF TX/RX testing under real-world conditions, with MLO, multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E test capabilities.[5] |
| R&D / early Wi‑Fi 8 signaling validation | Signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMX500 | Used for Wi‑Fi 8 RF signaling tests before final IEEE standard ratification.[17] | The cited Wi‑Fi 8 signaling context includes dRU and UEQM as new testing hurdles, and CMX500 is positioned as a one-box signaling tester covering WLAN including Wi‑Fi 7 and Wi‑Fi 8.[17] |
| Production RF test | Non-signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMP180 | Executes production RF measurements in non-signaling mode to reduce test time.[1] | CMP180 is positioned for Wi‑Fi 7 production non-signaling RF testing and supports Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz.[1] |
| Production / scalable MIMO RF test | Non-signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMP180 | Provides RF generator/analyzer resources for MIMO production-style testing.[12] | CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 units can scale to four analyzers/generators for 4x4 MIMO access points.[12] |
| Wi‑Fi 8 waveform exploration, not formal conformance | Non-signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMP180 | Verifies a 480 MHz WLAN waveform in loopback mode.[12] | The 480 MHz WLAN waveform is described only as a potential candidate for yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn, not as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification.[1] |
【推論】Use the **Signaling Tester first in R&D** to validate protocol-connected, real-world Wi‑Fi 7/8 behavior, then use the **Non-signaling Tester later in production** for faster RF measurement throughput.[5][1]

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將在 [[MWC 2024]] 展示最新 [[Wi-Fi 7]] R&D 與 production 測試方案，用於應對 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[5G]] parallel operation 的測試挑戰。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality，可讓 R&D engineers 以 single instrument setup 測試 cellular 與 non-cellular standards。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被描述為 production phase 的 non-signaling RF measurement tester，支援 cellular 與 non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將在 MWC 展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform；來源稱這是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。

Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity › 重點摘要
- 來源未標示發布日期；raw frontmatter `created: 2026-09-11`，本文 ingest 日期為 2026-09-15。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱在最終 IEEE standard ratification 之前，已將 first [[Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests]] 實作到 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester。
- 展示情境：[[MWC Barcelona 2026]]，[[Rohde & Schwarz]] booth 5A80，Fira Gran Via Barcelona，hall 5。
- 測試對象：[[Broadcom]] prototype next-generation WLAN device / prototype [[Wi-Fi 8]] device。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的焦點被描述為從 sheer speed 轉向 ultra-high reliability（[[UHR]]）performance。
- 來源稱 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 延續 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 的 core PHY parameters：supported frequencies up to 7.125 GHz、channel bandwidths up to 320 MHz、4096QAM modulation、[[MLO]]。
- 來源列出 [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的新 testing hurdles，包括 [[distributed resource units]]（dRU）與 [[unequal modulation]]（UEQM）。
- dRU measurements 被描述為可驗證 device boosting uplink transmit power 與 improving connection reliability 的 effectiveness。
- UEQM analysis 被描述為可評估 test device 是否能依 specified modulation coding scheme（MCS）combinations 正確 adapt modulation。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被定位為 modular、powerful one-box signaling tester，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR]] SA/NSA、[[NR-NTN]]、[[NB-NTN]]、Direct-to-Cell（[[D2C]] / [[DTC]]）與 WLAN including [[Wi‑Fi 7]] and [[Wi‑Fi 8]]。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
